heading: Introduction to Python
title: Introduction to Python
description: Learn the basics of Python programming language

dataList.data: Python is a versatile, high-level programming language known for its simplicity and readability. It's popular for web development, data science, AI, and automation.

Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. It was designed to be easy to read and write, with a focus on code readability. Python's popularity has grown tremendously due to its simplicity and powerful libraries.
Python is an interpreted language, which means code is executed line by line. This makes development faster and easier, though it can be slower than compiled languages for certain tasks.
Python uses indentation to define code blocks, making it highly readable. Unlike many languages, Python doesn't use curly braces or semicolons.
This simple line prints 'Hello, World!' to the console.
Python follows the 'Zen of Python' principles, emphasizing readability, simplicity, and explicitness. You can see these principles by running 'import this' in a Python interpreter.
Now that you have a basic understanding of Python, explore our sections on data types, control structures, functions, and more advanced topics like object-oriented programming and data structures.
